notes: DOC and PDF parsers now apply the same HwpPostprocessRules pipeline as HWP
DocParser._build_parsed_document now calls build_blocks(source_format='doc') and render_blocks_as_markdown instead of a simple paragraph split
PdfParser.parse now calls build_blocks(source_format='pdf') on extraction.markdown to populate blocks and chunks fields
build_blocks, chunk_blocks, and _make_chunk now accept a source_format parameter to generate doc-chunk-N and pdf-chunk-N style chunk IDs
LangChainRetrievalQAService now has a summarize_document() method that calls ChatOpenAI to generate a structured JSON summary
POST /api/summarize endpoint added: accepts document_id or source_name and returns summary_text, key_points, and document_type
GET /api/documents endpoint added: returns the list of structured documents available for summarization
The launcher UI now includes a Document Summary panel with a dropdown for document selection and a button to generate summaries
